ignoreValues.reason: Inter is URAL's committed brand sans, not an unexamined default. It is self-hosted, subsetted by unicode-range, and metric-matched to Noto Sans Bengali via size-adjust/ascent-override so that mixed English+Bengali lines share one line box. Replacing it is a bilingual layout change, not a font swap. See DESIGN.md -> Typography -> Two voices, two jobs.
